rule: An excluded task gets no hidden grade and no label, in small-model and frontier grading. load_labelled() drops all its checkpoints (every attempt and round) and reports them. run_frontier.py makes no call for it. The split is unchanged: the task stays a test task, excluded from evaluation.
scope: main test analysis (primary test, Holm family, Table 1)
A1.1 transfer (when HumanEval+ is the test target)
A1.2 32K arm (both arms of every paired comparison)

tasks.reason: The pinned EvalPlus 0.3.1 cannot give this task a valid pass. Its special find_zero oracle (evalplus/eval/__init__.py lines 187-189) ends with `continue`, which skips `details[i] = True` and `progress.value += 1`; untrusted_check then turns PASS into FAIL because len(details) != len(inputs). Every solution that does not time out grades 'fail'. Separately, the reference solution (Newton method) fails the residual oracle (atol 1e-4) on 7 of 788 plus inputs, so a repaired oracle would still fail calibration.
